Name: AT Reefs Mushroom Scarecrows
Author: Reef084
Description:
Textures for scarecrows that makes them mushrooms! us the paint bucket from Alternative Textures on your scarecrows (or rarecrows!) to make them mushrooms

11 textures including:
3 small mushroom colours (red, orange and blue)
2 ink cap textures (ink and no ink)
3 blue mushrooms (cone shaped, round shaped and spotty)
2 red mushroom textures (cone shaped and round)
A texture based on the vanilla purple mushroom!


This is my first mod ever so let me know if you have any suggestions :D especially if its new mushrooms you'd like added!
